description_en: Submits a saved semantic job for execution by name and returns the run and executor identifiers. A successful call indicates that the job has been submitted, not that the semantic model results have been generated
description_zh: 按已创建任务的 Name 提交执行并返回本次运行与执行器标识。调用成功表示已提交，不代表语义模型结果已经生成
name: RunSemanticJob

parameters.help_en: The name of the job to run. Use the Data.Name value from the CreateSemanticJob response or the Name value from a ListSemanticJobs list item. The Source, ResourceGroupId, and reference files of the job are determined by the definition saved at creation time
parameters.help_zh: 待运行任务的名称，使用 CreateSemanticJob 响应的 Data.Name 或 ListSemanticJobs 列表项的 Name。任务的 Source、ResourceGroupId 和参考文件由创建时保存的定义决定
parameters.name: name

schema.description_en: The standard response for submitting a semantic job run. The two identifiers in Data are used for result download and executor queries, respectively
schema.description_zh: 提交语义任务运行的标准响应。Data 中的两个标识分别用于结果下载和执行器查询

Data.description_en: The run information for this submission. A successful submission does not mean that the semantic model output has been generated. Use the detail operation to confirm the status before downloading results
Data.description_zh: 本次提交的运行信息。提交成功不代表语义模型产物已生成；请先用详情接口确认状态，再下载结果

CurrentSqlIndex.description_en: The current SQL fragment index returned by the executor in the submission response
CurrentSqlIndex.description_zh: 提交响应中执行器返回的当前 SQL 片段索引

Env.description_en: The runtime environment identifier returned by the executor in the submission response
Env.description_zh: 提交响应中执行器返回的运行环境标识

ExecTypes.description_en: The list of execution type codes returned by the executor in the submission response
ExecTypes.description_zh: 提交响应中执行器返回的执行类型编码列表

items.description_en: The list of execution type codes returned by the executor
items.description_zh: 执行器返回的执行类型编码列表

ExecutorJobId.description_en: The executor task identifier. Pass this value to the ExecutorJobId parameter of GetSemanticJobDetail, GetSemanticJobLog, or KillSemanticJob
ExecutorJobId.description_zh: 执行器任务标识；传给 GetSemanticJobDetail、GetSemanticJobLog 或 KillSemanticJob 的 ExecutorJobId

JobRunId.description_en: The unique identifier of this run. Pass this value to the JobRunId parameter of DownloadSemanticResults to obtain the output of this run
JobRunId.description_zh: 本次运行的唯一标识；传给 DownloadSemanticResults 的 JobRunId 可获取该次运行的产物

Statuses.description_en: The list of status codes returned by the executor in the submission response. The status at the submission stage does not indicate that the results are complete
Statuses.description_zh: 提交响应中执行器返回的状态编码列表；提交阶段的状态不表示结果已完成

items.description_en: The list of task status codes returned by the executor. A success status includes 3
items.description_zh: 执行器返回的任务状态编码列表；成功状态包含 3

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used for locating logs and troubleshooting issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志和排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
